name: INGCO Uruguay
description: Uruguayan online store of the exclusive INGCO agent, selling hand tools, power tools, generators, compressors, pumps and garden equipment, with prices in US dollars.
description_es: Tienda online del agente exclusivo de INGCO en Uruguay: herramientas manuales y eléctricas, generadores, compresores, bombas y equipos de jardín, con precios en dólares.

ships_to.notes: Homepage mentions express shipping to all Uruguay; conditions page says interior shipments go through DAC.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup points in Montevideo (Melilla and Reducto) listed on the conditions page.

shopping_notes: Some products show Reservar or Consultar instead of a purchase button, and many are marked Agotado.

sources.supports: Montevideo pickup points and interior shipping via DAC
Product categories, cart (Mi compra), USD prices, nationwide shipping mention
